note: Kentucky State Parks campground filling a wooded peninsula on Carr Fork Lake, beside the park's long sand beach. The pads sit in a shaded, grassy loop with 50-60 m of woods between the outer sites and the water. The park gate closes at 6 p.m. on Mondays and Tuesdays and 11 p.m. other nights. --Claude
summary: Kept. 39 W/E back-ins (15/30/50A, 30-60 ft; 6 walk-up only); $28 Sun-Thu / $33 Fri-Sat / $35 holiday; showers, restrooms, laundry; season Mar 15 - Nov 15 (closed now). WATERFRONT DOWN recommended: lakeview -> not waterfront (no lake in any of 39 official site photos, RA 'Near Water - no' on every site, outer pads 50-60 m back through woods and 10-13 m above the water). Dump moved to unknown (RA lists it under 'less than 1 mile' rather than in the park). Policy-row fee copies cleared; website fix.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED: stored lakeview -> not waterfront. This is a judgement call. The campground fills a ~180 m-wide peninsula. Leaf-off Esri imagery puts the outer north, west and east pads (north tip ~37.2343,-83.0022; west ~37.2339,-83.0027) 50-60 m from the shore through open deciduous woods. 3DEP has the pads at ~323 m and the water at 309.8 m (lidar surface), so they sit 10-13 m up. None of the 39 official RA photos (Sept 2008, leaf-on) shows water; 029 shows only the ground dropping through the trees. RA tags every site 'Near Water - no'. A winter glimpse from the outer pads is possible, but no photo confirms one, and 50-60 m of woods is more than a 'thin line'. AWH's unsure rule says go down. Old evidence ('pads set back ~25-50m from waterline behind thin shoreline fringe') was closer than measured. Carr Fork's summer pool was not found in a search; the lidar surface was used. Suggested evidence: 'Esri leaf-off + 3DEP 2026-11-24: outer pads 50-60 m from shore through open woods, 10-13 m above water; no lake in any of 39 RA site photos; RA Near Water - no on all sites = not waterfront'.
SEASON: stored 03-01..11-30 'Approximate' replaced by 03-15..11-15 from the RA calendar. RA's banner 'Status: Open through Mon Nov 15 2027' is misleading, since every night until Mar 14 2027 is 'X'.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 -> 50 (RA 'Electric Details: 15 & 30 & 50'). The old inclusion_evidence '14 w/ sewer' is on no page read; RA shows no sewer.
FACILITIES: dump dropped to unknown. RA lists 'Dump Station' under services less than 1 mile away, not within the park, and parks.ky.gov doesn't mention one.
BOOKING: 6 sites (001, 002, 015, 017, 019, 021) are walk-up only, matching the policy row's fcfs some_sites.
PIN 37.2334,-83.0023 sits in the middle of the loop. Fine. PHONE 606-642-4050 matches parks.ky.gov.
POLICY ROW state:KY: matches RA. No contradiction.
